The generic failure receipt does not establish the setup cause. Subsequently an independently reviewed narrow cleanup freshly classified every returned role scope without modifying roles, required fourteen exact child/job IDs absent, persisted deletion intent, and performed one exact empty-group DELETE. Final receipt SHA256 B01712CBB1F582A7DE03C3F0B3DB69835F6967F68E4CC59E1F15E999EB124EE5 and independent result review SHA256 507530184064B9FA5EBED548AC7FB630540549E2864096F66A8C2F7E6E72CC7C prove all fifteen exact resource/job IDs returned 404, no owned workspace tombstone remained, and default subscription was unchanged. No jobs, grants or new authentication were initiated. All failed attempts and diagnostic evidence are preserved; cleanup completion does not qualify ingestion or delivery. AUD-003 remains proposed and AUD-002/issue #1 stays separate.
